wallet.reason: Wallet liability is platform-wide. Remaining credits cannot be attributed to a gym or original provider without credit-consumption allocations.

recognized_revenue.reason: Membership recognition schedule, pause treatment and principal/agent policy are not configured.
Membership recognition schedule, pause treatment and principal/agent policy are not configured.

renewals.reason: Renewal lineage is not recorded; another purchase is not assumed to be a renewal.

membership_conversion.reason: A conversion cohort and attribution window have not been approved.

definitions.collections: Verified, fulfilled and unrefunded purchases, counted once on confirmed payment date; includes wallet-funded consideration, excludes wallet top-ups. Missing dates are not guessed.
definitions.earnings: Recorded gym entitlement and FitiGo net commission only; may cover fewer transactions than collections. Multi-Gym collections are not FitiGo earnings.
definitions.visits: Successful matched check-ins within the QR validity window, deduplicated by purchased visitor or membership daily access.
definitions.rates: Cancellation rate: cancelled / scheduled bookings. No-show rate: authorized no-shows / (attended bookings + authorized no-shows).
definitions.inventory: Registered users, gyms, active memberships and unused wallet are current balances. Other measures follow the selected dates.
